questions.question: Which of the following States sends only one representative to the Rajya Sabha in India?
Natanz, Isfahan and Fordow are nuclear sites in which country?

Who among the following is NOT a member of committee formed by Supreme court to inquire into the matter related to alleged discovery of cash pile at official residence of Delhi High Court's judge Yashwant Verma in March 2025?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Justice Hima Kohli) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a power of the High Court over Subordinate Courts?
options: Appointing District Judges directly without consulting Governor
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Appointing District Judges directly without consulting Governor) है।

questions.question: Which of the following Manipravalam texts of the 14th century deals with grammar and poetics?
The Neyveli lignite mines are located in which State of India?
​The Indian Government aims to achieve 500 GW non-fossil based electricity generation capacity by the end of which of the following years?
What is the total cost of India's National Quantum Mission from 2023-24 to 2030-31?
In which reaction does a diazonium ion, ArN2+, decompose and a halogen, X, is replaced by Cu(I) as a catalyst?
Who became the second Indian to score a double century and century in the same Test after Sunil Gavaskar in July 2025?

The Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms (Government of India Act, 1919) were introduced in response to growing Indian political aspirations. Which feature best represents its attempt to accommodate Indian demands?
options: Introduction of dyarchy, which gave Indians some measure of control over certain provincial subjects
Empowering the Viceroy to legislate without any Indian input
Abolition of the British Cabinet’s role in Indian affairs
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Introduction of dyarchy, which gave Indians some measure of control over certain provincial subjects) है।

questions.question: A headless statue of Kanishka, found at __________, reflects that Kushan horsemen wore trousers while riding.
Which of the following physical features of India covers the largest surface area of the country?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (The Peninsular Plateau) है।

questions.question: How can the President of India resign from office?
options: By addressing the resignation letter to the Prime Minister
By addressing the resignation letter to the Speaker of Lok Sabha
By addressing the resignation letter to the Chief Justice of India
By addressing the resignation letter to the Vice-President
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (By addressing the resignation letter to the Vice-President) है।

questions.question: In February 2025, who won the 'Sportstar of the Year (Female)' at the Sportstar Aces Awards?
Which of the following accurately describes the Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER)?
options: It functions as the site of DNA replication in both plant and animal cells.
The ER are membranous tubules and sacs involved in protein and lipid synthesis.
The ER is primarily found in prokaryotic cells and serves as the site of photosynthesis.
The ER is responsible for the synthesis of ATP in eukaryotic cells.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (The ER are membranous tubules and sacs involved in protein and lipid synthesis.) है।

questions.question: _____________ celebrations are spread over four days, beginning with Nahay Khay and ending with Usha Arghya falling on the on the sixth day of Kartik Shukla.
In which year was the Export Credit Guarantee Corporation of India established?
Coelenterates that are cylindrical in shape are called:
Under which of the following  ministries does the Kendriya Hindi Sansthan, an autonomous institution, operate?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Ministry of Education) है।
